programmes.d: Stan's killer says Rachel and Tony are marked for death by a hit man whom no one has ever seen.
Tony is shot and enlists the help of a physiotherapist to help him walk again. While he is out, Cyd is put in charge of the murder investigation of a police officer.
As the search for a cop killer intensifies, Tony begins to doubt his own recovery.
In a Senate executive session, a falsely accused Vinnie is systematically stripped of his honor, even as Masters' diabolical scheme is exposed.
When a cantankerous Mike McPike is asked to leave his nursing home — the latest in a string of them — he "retires" temporarily to the home of his son Frank.
Sid Royce, the man who worked for Sonny Steelgrave, is placed in the Witness Protection Program after being arrested.
McCall finds her loyalties sharply divided when an important murder case being prosecuted by the Assistant District Attorney, with whom she is in love, is jeopardized by Hunter.
Mysterious tape recordings accusing a company of illegally dumping toxic waste seem like a prank until Hunter and McCall find that someone is willing to kill to conceal the truth.
When Hunter confronts the police department to defend the actions of a Chinese-American policewoman critically wounded in the line of duty, the pair heads to Chinatown.
While investigating an armed robbery, Tony goes undercover and hires an escort to get some important information. He is shocked when his friend's daughter shows up as the escort.
Tony uncovers the shakedown of a community of illegal immigrants; David wants an earring to impress a girl.
Tony believes an officer posing as a corrupt cop to expose a crime ring may actually be the genuine article.
Vinnie joins his old neighborhood friends for a bachelor party but ends up finding one of his pals in trouble with a loan shark.
Vinnie goes underground as a small-town deputy to root out the corruption in a company town run by one man: the reclusive Old Man Volchek.
